title: Packing wrapped rows in a tall box
summary: align-content spreads or packs the wrapped lines of a flex container that has spare height.
explanation: align-content works on the lines of a wrapping flex container, not on the items within a line. It only matters when the container is taller than its lines need, which is why this box has a fixed height.

align-content: space-between pushes the first line to the top and the last to the bottom, with the gaps between lines sharing the rest. flex-start packs them at the top instead, leaving the space empty below.
tryThis: Change align-content to flex-start: all the lines pack together at the top.
Change align-content to center: the lines group in the middle.
Remove the fixed height: the container shrinks to fit the lines and align-content has no effect.
